description: needsReconfirm(report, now) — the sheet prompt switches from 'Estiveste lá agora?' to 'Ainda está assim?' once the latest report is more than reconfirmAfterMs old. Strictly greater-than, same convention as statusOf. needsReconfirm() on its own does NOT know about staleness — it will happily return true for a report that is hours past staleAfterMs too. The actual UI prompt is a composition of needsReconfirm() with statusOf(), given by promptFormula below; a report already gone stale must fall back to the first-visit prompt, not the reconfirm one.
promptFormula: prompt = (report != null && statusOf(machine, now) != 'stale' && needsReconfirm(report, now)) ? promptAindaEstaAssim : promptEstivesteLaAgora

cases.description: Report is 1ms under 3h old: not yet asking for reconfirmation.
Report is exactly 3h old. Threshold side that wins: still the first-visit prompt (needsReconfirm uses '> reconfirmAfterMs', not '>=').
Report is 1ms over 3h old: switches to the reconfirm prompt.
A machine with no report at all never shows the reconfirm prompt.
Report is exactly 18h old (staleAfterMs), the last instant before it goes stale: statusOf still reports it fresh, so the reconfirm prompt still shows.

Report is 1ms over 18h old. needsReconfirm() on its own still returns true (10h+ past a 3h threshold), but the machine is now stale, so the composed prompt must fall back to the first-visit copy rather than asking to reconfirm a status nobody can see anymore.
Report is 19h old (68400000ms), well past staleAfterMs: same suppression as the boundary case, with more margin.
